user.title: Connect EcoVolter
user.description: Enter the charger's serial number, IP address or hostname and Local API secret.

data.host: Serial number, IP address or hostname

price_type.title: Electricity price
price_type.description: How should the charging scheduler calculate the price?

prices.title: Prices
prices.description:
**Sensor:** choose the price sensor (empty = auto-detect a final-price sensor or Czech Energy Spot Prices). Distribution is only added to Czech Energy Spot Prices – leave 0 for a final-price sensor.

**Fixed two-rate tariff:** energy and distribution price per kWh in VT and NT incl. VAT. For a single rate enter the same prices for VT and NT.

tariff.title: Low and high tariff (HDO)
tariff.description: HDO sensor: a sensor with low-tariff windows (list attribute with start/end, e.g. ČEZ distribuce) or a binary sensor (on = NT). VT windows: manual fallback, e.g. 8:00-9:00, 12:00-13:00, 16:00-17:00, 19:00-20:00. Used for the fixed tariff, Low tariff only mode and sensors without tariff info.

car.title: Car (optional)
car.description: For charging to a target %: the car's battery level sensor, battery capacity and charging efficiency (losses, typically 85–92 %).

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the API secret.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while communicating with EcoVolter.

init.description: Refresh interval and electricity price type.
